title: Bali Sakina Sojao
body:
Soja sakina soja sakina (x4)
Bali sakina sojao baba ke dukhiya sojao
1. Bole shahe dee'n yeh rokar sakina
Aaj mayassar hai baba ka seena(x2)
Kal yeh na hoga sojao
<<MINI>>
Baba ke dukhiya.....
Bali sakina sojao..(x2)
<<DIVIDER>>
2. Yaad chacha ke jo aati hai tumko
Pyas ke shidath rulati hai tumko(x2)
Tadpo na itna sojao
<<MINI>>
Baba ke dukhiyaa....
Bali sakina sojao.. (x2)
<<DIVIDER>>
2. Hoga sitam tujhpe aye meri dukhtar
Chin jayegi tere kaano se gouhar(x2)
Khoon bhayega sojao
<<MINI>>
Baba ke dukhiyaa.......
Bali sakina sojao.. (X2)
<<DIVIDER>>
3. Shimr e sitamgar rulata rahega
Tujhko tamachey lagata rahega
Rone na dega sojao
<<MINI>>
Baba ke dukhiyaa.......
Bali sakina sojao.. (X2)
<<DIVIDER>>
4. Khayegi jab tu layee'n kay tamachay
Hojayege tere ruksar neelay
Dard bhi hoga sojao
<<MINI>>
Baba ke dukhiyaa.......
Bali sakina sojao.. (X2)
<<DIVIDER>>
4. Badh jayeegi Teri tashna dahaani
Zalim dekha kar bahayega paani
Tujhko na dega sojao
<<MINI>>
Baba ke dukhiyaa ......
Bali sakina sojao.. (X2)
<<DIVIDER>>
5. Tere gale me jo Rassi bandhegi
Rukh jayegi bibi saase tumhari
Hoyegi ezaa sojao
<<MINI>>
baba ke dukhiyaa ......
Bali sakina sojao.. (X2)
<<DIVIDER>>
6. Saath tumhare rahega baradar
Jalti zamee'n par tu naize pay asghar
Sabr hai karna sojao
<<MINI>>
Baba ke dukhiyaa........
Bali sakina sojao...
<<DIVIDER>>
7. Pusht say naqe ke jab tu giregi
Aye meri dukhiya musibaath pay Teri(x2) Royega kunba sojao
<<MINI>>
Baba ke dukhiya.........
Bali sakina sojao... (X2)
<<DIVIDER>>
8. Parwaz kehte the roro ke sarwer
Meri judayi ka gham tujhko dukhtar(x2)
Sone na dega sojao..
<<MINI>>
Baba ki dukhiya...
Bali sakina sojao...
